serviceDescriptions.GST registration and return filing: GST registration and monthly or quarterly GST return filing for traders, shops, service businesses and online sellers who need their GSTIN, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and annual returns done correctly and on time.
serviceDescriptions.Income tax return filing: Income tax return filing for salaried people, freelancers and small business owners, including handling notices from the income tax department.
serviceDescriptions.Bookkeeping and accounting: Monthly books on Tally or Zoho Books for small businesses that don't want a full-time accountant.
